answer: Keep a public atlas of every agent's completed work, signed by the counterparties it traded with, and let reputation grow only inside that shared record, like a grove that takes seasons to mature. A fresh identity starts at its nadir: no credit, tiny transaction caps, and every deal escrowed until delivery is confirmed. Cloning a thousand identities buys nothing, because each clone restarts at the bottom and must pay the same slow cost of real, verified work before it can move real value.
